title: 4/22 new heartbeat monitor paged Healthchecks falsely: no heartbeat during cold-wake predictions and during the result-polling sleep
tier_reason: false liveness pages at storm cadence on the monitor's first day: every cold-wake prediction, and ~2-3 /fail pings per 15-min result-polling iteration (12 stale entries in about 2 h before discovery)

contract.text: The external heartbeat monitor pings Healthchecks /fail only when the scheduler is stalled; a RUNNING heartbeat stays under 5 minutes old while the daemon is doing legitimate work.
contract.source: commit d4dae2c body (state-specific freshness thresholds; on stale: hc-ping /fail -> email alert); docs/superpowers/plans/2026-04-20-scheduler-hardening.md Task 1

mechanism.text: run_single_check and _refresh_pick_at_fallback called run_and_pick (data refresh + model load + ~270-batter prediction, 5-6 min on a cold wake) without refreshing the heartbeat, so check_heartbeat.py saw a RUNNING heartbeat older than 300 s and pinged /fail
run_result_polling slept 15 minutes between iterations with no heartbeat refresh, so the monitor's 5-minute RUNNING threshold fired at minutes 5 and 10 of every polling cycle

residual.text: The 0830ef4 heartbeat_watchdog thread wrote RUNNING unconditionally, which later masked wedged cascades (audit H5); closed by the progress-aware watchdog 18efce1 (6/11).
Inline shadow prediction still ran outside heartbeat_watchdog until 150ed4c (5/09, E47/I-047).

watchdog.trigger: a Healthchecks /fail from the heartbeat monitor while the scheduler journal shows the same process making progress (prediction/poll lines) inside the stale window is a monitor false positive; a stale heartbeat with no progress lines and no process exit is a real stall
watchdog.recovery_assertion: a full cold-wake prediction and a full result-polling day complete with no /fail pings and no restarts

evidence.what: first Phase B cron run at 13:15 ET that day reported 'running state but timestamp 302s old (>300s)' and pinged /fail to Healthchecks, then /success at 13:20 when the prediction finished; the check false-fired every cold wake

run_result_polling's 15-min sleep had no heartbeat refresh; observed live that day when the scheduler entered result_polling for the day's slate: 12 stale=True log entries in about 2 h before discovery via Healthchecks log review

evidence.locator: commit d4dae2c body and scripts/check_heartbeat.py at d4dae2c
evidence.what: the monitor (cron */5, added 4/22 12:04 ET) treats RUNNING as fresh only under 5 min and pings /fail on stale
